variants.headline: Building finished and handed over
variants.sub: The project {project} has been completed and handed over by {builder}.
variants.body:
The builder {builder} has finished and handed over {project}. It opens next month. The distinction between handover and opening matters to an assessment of {target}: a building has been delivered, while its entry into use is the following stage rather than an event already accomplished by this notice.

A handover deserves attention to the work behind it, not only the name attached to the project. Labour should recognise a completed undertaking while remembering that a building's purpose concerns people. The achievement should not make those who build or those expected to use it disappear from the account.

We remain critical of {target}. A completed building should not place overall stewardship beyond scrutiny, or turn a particular delivery into automatic approval of every judgment surrounding the project and its purpose. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.
